decisions.reason: Fixing caption text in one position does not change the separate requirements for clean editing, effects, animations, or transitions.
Caption positioning does not change permitted source material or video-selection constraints.
The source explicitly identifies caption placement as the only needed change and leaves lesson completeness and standalone comprehension unchanged.
The requested correction concerns text placement, not selection of stronger or more impactful source moments.
The caption-position decision does not alter the wind-noise removal requirement.
The source makes no change to the required 45-to-60-second clip duration.
A caption-placement correction has no necessary effect on the Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training, or responsibilities.
The source reviews current clips but does not change the historical qualification method, success condition, clip count, or deadline.
The source requests an editing correction but does not change the publishing destination, caption, hashtags, posting window, frequency, or tracking instructions.
The requested caption correction is an application of the existing review gate and does not change approval authority, publication eligibility, or rejected-clip handling.
Caption placement does not change the submission channel, folder requirements, batch size, deadline, or review-link workflow.
The caption correction does not change the monthly approved-clip quota, counting rule, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
